Hi Lena —

Thanks for the details and the sample traffic. Below is a concise description and two pricing options we commonly offer for Dedicated burst behavior. I also attached a short one-pager (burst_pricing_options_v2.pdf) with the same examples.

Summary of behavior (defaults):
- Reserved commit = guaranteed pool capacity for steady traffic. You can pin model variants and throughput guarantees to this pool.
- Burst add-on = additional capacity above reserved, available when the pool is saturated. Two billing modes: flat bundle or metered surge.
- Cooldown window = default 15 minutes. If two spikes happen within the cooldown, we consider them part of the same burst for metering. If spikes are separated by >cooldown, they are billed as separate bursts. Cooldown is configurable at contract time.
- Hard caps = by default we allow up to 3x baseline GPU pool for bursts, higher caps are available but require capacity reservation and a slightly higher commitment.

Pricing options (examples using your sample numbers):
1) Flat burst bundle (predictable):
   - Monthly bolt-on that covers up to N burst-hours (example: 24 GPU-hours at 3x baseline) for $12,000/month.
   - No per-burst metering within the included hours; overage at 1.8x standard token rate.

2) Metered surge (flexible):
   - Burst capacity billed at a surge multiplier on top of hosted token/unit rates. Example: 2.5x standard per-token rate during burst windows.
   - Cooldown applies: multiple spikes within 15 minutes merge into one billable burst window.
   - Monthly cap option: we can put a soft cap (you receive alerts) or a hard cap that blocks additional burst beyond X spend.

Worked example (using your 3x baseline, 4 one-hour spikes/month):
- Baseline commit: sized to 80% of your 95th pct -> recommended 8 GPUs (reserved).
- During a 1-hour 3x spike you consume equivalent of 24 GPU-hours. With metered surge at 2.5x, those tokens are billed at 2.5x rate for that hour.
- Estimated incremental monthly burst cost (metered): ~$9,600 (4 spikes * hourly burst token consumption * 2.5x). Exact depends on model mix; we can re-run with model names if you share.

Recommendation: If you prefer predictable billing and can estimate burst-hours, go with the flat bundle. If your burst profile is bursty/irregular, metered surge with a monthly hard cap is better.

Next steps:

- Vanessa — if we want to offer a concession on the bolt-on price for a 6-month minimum, happy to discuss.

- Preferred: Metered surge with a hard monthly cap + 30% discount on the first quarter of surge fees. This gives them flexibility and lowers up-front cost.
- Fallback: Flat bundle at 18% below list if they commit to a 6-month bolt-on/commit term.

Additional notes:
- Set cooldown to 30 minutes for this account (their spikes are often clustered). That will reduce double-billing across near-back-to-back spikes.
- Approve up to 3x baseline default cap; if they request 4x+ we require a signed capacity reservation addendum.
- Finance needs to approve the 30% trial discount; if not approved, offer 20% with a usage tier rebate.
